diagnosis.combinedRowOmission: When BuildOcrPanels had not marked the local panel as equipment, AddStructuredFieldLabels passed equipment=false. The old parser then dropped every field on a combined row except the last one, so Weapon Def/Magic Def/INT/LUK/Remaining Enhancements disappeared after the first value.
diagnosis.missingAliases: Evasion, Attack Speed, Upgrade Slots, short ATT/ATK and related critical/defence variants were absent from the generic field table.
diagnosis.recognition: The equipment gate required a short literal anchor set (req, remaining enhancements, or both defences); partially OCR'd tooltips never reached the equipment path.
diagnosis.valueErasure: The old whole-row translation could erase a value before the structured field plan ran, and the merged key/value branch repainted the value with an averaged ink colour.

genericAliases: weapon/magic attack, weapon/magic defence, ATT/ATK forms
speed, movement speed, accuracy, avoidability, jump, HP/MP, fame
implementation.exactValues: Raw OCR value substring is retained byte-for-byte: signs (+/-/U+2212/full-width), percentages, decimals, thousands separators, OCR-confusable digits and every parenthesized correction such as +36 (40 -4).
implementation.protectedLayout: Each field replaces only the translated key. The measured value has its own KeepClearBounds guard, so the value pixels and their colours are never repainted. A safe merged-word split leaves a two-pixel gap; if no safe split exists the original row is preserved with merged-value-region-unsafe.
implementation.sharedTypography: EquipmentPanelTypography: Microsoft YaHei, Pixel unit, one panel size derived from measured row height (floor 11px, cap 22px). No independent 8px squeeze.
implementation.combinedRows: Row-level equipment context and exact continuation checks keep every parsed field on requirements/defence/attribute rows.
implementation.partialOcr: Missing colons, missing value rectangles and key-only rows are handled; missing values are not invented.
implementation.evidenceStages: equipment-panel / equipment-coverage log recognised, matched, prepared, valuePixels, partialValues, mergedText, preserved and preservedReason; equipment-paint log records prepared/painted/preserved/preservedReason.
